scope: 六英雄主武器封印至七式，95普通晋阶配方（72普通分支+23真分支）及29同阶段提真；不代替角色晋级或英雄强化转移。

published.facts: 甄凤柏先完成角色晋级，武器12阶段最低强化1/3/3/4/4/5/5/6/7/7/7/7，普通晋阶下降1；提真另算且130装备/强化7以上、金刚水玉及真龙宝器[武器]。神物之石在血雨丸四转与三式任务取得。
专属武器通常晋阶需天世宝血珠且降低强化，强化转移另算。

project_adoption: 其他五英雄来源没有逐阶段完整材料/强化表，项目各职业显式采用同一最低强化梯度与降1规则以保证可实现；不将甄凤柏来源宣称为六英雄官方表。
天世宝血珠在六至十二武器晋阶各消耗1至7个；一至五阶段无材料但有费用，属于明确本地改编，不把来源未知视为官方免费。
提真固定消耗各1材料及500万两、强化下降2，普通晋阶必成；数量/费用/降2均为项目值。
NPC采用现有泫勃刀剑笑，非声称还原黑风会或司空揽杰的官网武器任务。
神物之石仅甄凤柏普通四转/三式各给1，数量1是项目选择；其他五英雄本地晋阶附奖明确0，未证明官网无奖励。
所有配方保持一次有效初始血统，禁止换职业、跨级、从真还原普通或重复制造第二件主武器。

new_fields.enhancement: source actual enhancement minus exact recipe enhancement_loss
new_fields.exclusive_weapon_advancement_stage: promotion target stage or unchanged conversion stage
new_fields.true_equipment: unchanged promotion branch, false→true conversion only
new_fields.provenance: new instance source ID + command + recipe receipt

instance_transform.derived_stats: recompute all registered target contributions from exact definition and transformed growth inputs once: base, real_enhancement, synthesis, awakening, attribute_stone, jade, evolution and null boost. No carried source cache or twice-applied enhancement loss.
instance_transform.other_side_effects: no character rank/quest/skills/points/HP restoration/XP/practice/merit; only explicit reward_items
instance_transform.no_implicit_fields: only legitimately absent optional fields according to owning schema may remain absent; unknown or damaged fields are errors, never convert to empty

reward_policy.reward_scope: personal permanent character ledger, not current weapon instance or world; retained across transfer/new instance IDs/world change
reward_policy.already_rewarded: if source/ledger is otherwise valid and same stage reward already exists, reject inconsistent replay before costs; do not silently award or suppress a second reward
reward_policy.commit: costs + source consumed + weapon output + optional material reward + stage marker + receipt atomic
reward_policy.no_other_paths: enhancement, true conversion and hero transfer never emit divine_mystery_stone
reward_policy.stone_function_boundary: 神物之石仍禁止直接使用；英雄武器合成与神物之石.v1.json采用本地四属性/50%单槽变更与六英雄有费制作，原官网完整池/概率仍未知。

transaction.preview: show complete source/target registered growth values and all typed derived contributions, exact real enhancement loss, costs, reward and final capacity/weight; validate original inventory first, no quote from base+enhancement alone
transaction.capacity_weight: compute final state after materials+source removal, one weapon in freed source slot and reward into inventory. stone reward can require one new material slot; final weight includes reward10g. Failure preserves all inputs, never use ground/mail or later free delivery.
transaction.same_weight: all family stages are explicit constant class weight; normal stage1..5 without reward has unchanged final carried weight, stage4 zhen adds10g if no material consumed; other rows subtract material weights and add explicit rewards.
transaction.failure: cancellation, stale quote, unmet condition, insufficient silver/materials/space/weight or incompatible field: no source/fee/material/RNG/revision changes
transaction.commit: host serializes character, validates on copy then commits money, input/source/output/reward/lineage/ledger receipt and revision once; always100% no random
transaction.deduplication: original same-command payload returns same receipt before looking for consumed source; different payload same ID rejects; a new command cannot re-use consumed source
transaction.save_failure: keep committed memory/unsaved marker; retry same snapshot save, never re-run costs or grants
transaction.lan: requester owns all costs/source/reward; no party sharing or leader qualification
transaction.load: reject duplicate lineage, source and output both owned, mismatched stage/true, invalid reward markers or broken receipt ancestry; never auto-repair

remaining_dependencies: 英雄合成、火/毒属性、觉醒/四神、奇玉与进化均有独立采用合同，当前三名NPC武者投影已采用；其他元素/普通武器/防具、附加强化及完整反气功预算仍待。
神物之石本地变更/制作已采用；原官网完整属性池与概率缺口保留，其他八大奇宝范围待核。
白龙刀/黑灵剑/青雨丸等旁支另行采用；七式强化转移12配方由英雄武器强化转移.v1.json明确项目采用。
Godot真实晋阶/提真、背包/金钱/保存/LAN及经济平衡仍未实现验证。
